# UI & Visual Requirements Checklist: Bases-Backed E-Reader Library

**Purpose**: Validate that requirements describing visible elements — the library grid, read-state
and progress overlays, reader chrome, sidebar tabs, and empty states — are complete, specific, and
measurable enough to build from
**Created**: 2026-08-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness — Library View

- [ ] CHK001 Are cover thumbnail dimensions, aspect ratio, and crop-versus-letterbox handling specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are grid density and column-count requirements defined across viewport widths? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the visual hierarchy between cover, title, and progress specified when several properties are displayed at once? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Is overflow behaviour defined when the reader selects more properties than a tile can show? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK005 Are loading-state requirements defined for covers and for a library still rendering? [Gap, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK006 Is an empty state specified for a library containing no books, and for a filter matching nothing? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK007 Are hover, focus, and active state requirements defined for cover tiles? [Gap, Consistency]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it specified where a book opens when its cover is selected — same tab, new tab, or split? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity — Read State & Progress

- [ ] CHK009 Is the form of the read-state indication specified, rather than only its existence? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Is read state required to be distinguishable by something other than colour alone? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the position and size of the progress bar or percentage on a tile specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Are legibility requirements defined for overlays sitting on arbitrary cover artwork? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the distinction between "unread" and "0% progress" expressed in visual terms a reviewer can check? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Is it specified where the reader chooses between percentage and bar, given it is a view-level setting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK015 Can "readable placeholder carrying title and author" be objectively evaluated? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Completeness — Reader Surface

- [ ] CHK016 Are the placement and persistence of reader controls specified, including whether they auto-hide while reading? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the visual treatment of highlights specified, including overlapping highlights? [Gap, Spec §FR-016b]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the mapping from highlight type to visual encoding specified, and constrained to remain legible in both themes? [Gap, Spec §FR-020a]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the in-reader presentation of an unanchored highlight defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for how the reader surface relates to Obsidian conventions such as readable line length? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK021 Are text-selection affordances on touch devices specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, §FR-038]

## Requirement Completeness — Sidebar Tabs

- [ ] CHK022 Is the state of each of the three tabs specified when no book is open? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, §FR-025, §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK023 Are the tabs' icons, ordering, and relationship to Obsidian's native right sidebar defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, §FR-025, §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the visual distinction between a bookmark entry and a highlight entry specified, given both derive from one entry kind? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028a, §FR-028c]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the visual treatment of the current-position indicator in the outline specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK026 Are the empty states for the highlights and bookmarks tabs specified, as FR-027 does for the outline? [Gap, Coverage]

## Cross-Cutting Visual Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 Are contrast requirements stated for both light and dark themes, rather than assumed from theme adoption? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK028 Are minimum touch-target sizes specified for mobile? [Measurability, Spec §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK029 Are keyboard navigation and focus-order requirements defined for the library grid and sidebar tabs? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK030 Is mirroring of interface chrome specified for right-to-left locales, separately from rendering book content? [Gap, Coverage]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
